apks.help: The project ships a patch, not an APK. Get the original Crazy Taxi for Android 6.0-80 file legally, download crazywilly.xdelta from the releases, apply it with Delta Patcher, and rename the result from .apkm to .apk. Then pick that file here.

steps.text: Open Crazy Taxi VR Standalone from your app library and choose your driver.

notes: The patch is made for com.sega.CrazyTaxiplayhaven_6.0-80_2arch_7dpi_24lang_1feat_017e8b1c582569ff9682193551b7e22c_apkmirror.com.apkm. Uncertain: an .apkm is normally a split bundle, yet the guide renames the patched file to .apk and installs it as one APK. Delta Patcher: https://github.com/marco-calautti/DeltaPatcher. qgp could later apply the xdelta itself.
